members.name: Raj Rathod
members.bio: Raj is the founder of WarNodes and leads all technical operations across the platform. He is responsible for designing, managing, and improving the entire hosting infrastructure to ensure high performance, stability, and security for all customers.

responsibilities.label: VPS, game server, proxy, and web hosting setup
DDoS protection implementation and security management
Infrastructure scaling and future technology planning
Uptime, reliability, and service quality management

Customer Support Management and Ticket Resolution

Maintaining a professional and active community environment

members.name: Shubh Gupta
